description: SOLID golden corpus (E7), scored with `stoa eval test/corpus/solid/project --expected test/corpus/solid/expected.json --solid`. Each entry is a finding that SHOULD be produced; any other produced finding is a false positive. Negatives in the project: state holder and model dependencies (StatePage), other exceptions (Tired), test doubles (MockBird), a single empty member (Mostly), the composition root (lib/main.dart: a library with a top-level main()).
